completion.text: {"insufficient_evidence": false, "answer": "The pilot did not set the throttle's friction lock before hand propping the engine, so when the engine rpm increased the airplane moved forward and hit the credit card machine [20191230X15852:analysis]. The parking brake also malfunctioned: the airplane moved even after the brake was applied, though the reason for the malfunction could not be determined [20191230X15852:analysis][20191230X15852:factual]. The pilot had set the throttle, mixture, and parking brake before hand propping, and the engine appeared to be at idle before the rpm increased [20191230X15852:factual]. An FAA inspector found the throttle's friction lock was working [20191230X15852:analysis]."}
